name: mcp-manager
description: Local web UI to view, edit, toggle and health-check MCP servers across Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Codex

scripts.vendor:mcp-remote:
T=$(mktemp -d) && npm i --prefix $T --no-audit --no-fund mcp-remote@0.14.3 esbuild && $T/node_modules/.bin/esbuild $T/node_modules/mcp-remote/dist/proxy.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --keep-names --legal-comments=none --outfile=vendor/mcp-remote.mjs --banner:js="// mcp-remote@0.14.3 bundled with esbuild (npm run vendor:mcp-remote); licenses: mcp-remote.LICENSES.txt
import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" && rm -rf $T
